data.one_liner: Draw customizable arrows between any widgets in your app.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to draw customizable arrows connecting different widgets inside a Flutter application. It supports targeting multiple elements and redrawing on events like scrolling.
use_when: You need to connect widgets visually with arrows
You are building tutorials or guides pointing to UI elements
avoid_when: You need complex diagramming with draggable nodes and advanced graph features
strengths: Simple API to draw arrows between arbitrary widgets
Supports multiple targets from a single source
Customizable arrow heads, angles, and arcs
weaknesses: Limited to connecting widgets rather than being a full diagramming solution
